<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Fixes #58719 by classifying MFU/MBU work from the non-speculative token count instead of the total number of scheduled rows.

## Claims

- Bills speculative decode verification rows as decode logits work.
- Handles `-1` padding in newly scheduled speculative requests.
- Preserves ordinary prefill, chunked prefill, and resumed prefill accounting.

## Validation

- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/v1/metrics tests/v1/metrics/test_perf_metrics.py -k step_perf_stats_classifies_requests -v` (`6 passed`)
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/v1/metrics tests/v1/metrics/test_perf_metrics.py -v` (`78 passed`)
- `.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files vllm/v1/metrics/perf.py tests/v1/metrics/test_perf_metrics.py` (passed)

The focused regression test covers ordinary new prefill, decode, chunked prefill, speculative decode, padded speculative decode, and resumed prefill. Validation ran on macOS ARM with Python 3.12; no GPU execution is required because the change only affects analytic performance accounting.

Model evaluation is not applicable because this change does not affect model execution or outputs.

## Details

The existing code treats every cached request with more than one scheduled token as prefill. During speculative decoding, however, the scheduler includes verification rows in that total, so `num_tokens > 1` undercounts unembedding work by billing only one logits row.

Subtracting the number of scheduled speculative tokens recovers the scheduler phase semantics. The same calculation is used for requests newly sent to workers, where speculative slots may contain `-1` padding. A request that still schedules more than one non-speculative token remains prefill, preserving resumed and chunked-prefill behavior.

I reviewed and understand every changed line and the phase-classification behavior covered by the regression tests. I also rechecked open PRs for #58719 and related speculative decode metrics terms; no other open PR implements this fix.

AI assistance was used for code analysis, implementation, test design, and preparation of this PR update. I remain responsible for the change and its validation.

@@ -517,6 +517,61 @@ def test_model_metrics_aggregation():
     assert total_flops == sum(breakdown.values())
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    (
+        "is_new_request",
+        "num_scheduled_tokens",
+        "spec_decode_tokens",
+        "expected_num_logits_tokens",
+    ),
+    [
+        pytest.param(True, 2, [], 1, id="new-prefill"),
+        pytest.param(False, 1, [], 1, id="decode"),
+        pytest.param(False, 2, [], 1, id="chunked-prefill"),
+        pytest.param(False, 3, [11, 12], 3, id="speculative-decode"),
+        pytest.param(True, 3, [-1, -1], 3, id="padded-speculative-decode"),
+        pytest.param(True, 4, [11, 12], 1, id="resumed-prefill"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_step_perf_stats_classifies_requests(
+    is_new_request,
+    num_scheduled_tokens,
+    spec_decode_tokens,
+    expected_num_logits_tokens,
+):
+    """Test request phase classification with speculative tokens."""
+    model_metrics = ModelMetrics.__new__(ModelMetrics)
+    unembed_metrics = UnembedMetrics(
+        hidden_size=8,
+        vocab_size=16,
+        weight_byte_size=2,
+        activation_byte_size=2,
+        tp_size=1,
+    )
+    model_metrics.metrics = [unembed_metrics]
+    new_request = SimpleNamespace(req_id="r0", num_computed_tokens=16)
+    scheduler_output = SimpleNamespace(
+        scheduled_new_reqs=[new_request] if is_new_request else [],
+        scheduled_cached_reqs=SimpleNamespace(
+            req_ids=[] if is_new_request else ["r0"],
+            num_computed_tokens=[] if is_new_request else [16],
+        ),
+        num_scheduled_tokens={"r0": num_scheduled_tokens},
+        scheduled_spec_decode_tokens=(
+            {"r0": spec_decode_tokens} if spec_decode_tokens else {}
+        ),
+    )
+
+    perf_stats = model_metrics.get_step_perf_stats_per_gpu(scheduler_output)
+
+    assert perf_stats.num_flops_per_gpu == (
+        2
+        * expected_num_logits_tokens
+        * unembed_metrics.hidden_size
+        * unembed_metrics.vocab_size
+    )
+
